text:
jamie: Heads up — we're seeing a short burst of 503s from /v1/embeddings in eu-west1 starting 09:03. Pattern points at KV memory growth on embed-runtime v2.3.3 causing intermittent OOMs and request failures. I have a hotfix that pins runtime to v2.4.0 which includes the KV GC fix. Proposing a micro-canary: 1 node for 3m, then 100% if stable. Need ops + product OK for expedited schedule.
rohan: Micro-canary sounds reasonable. What's the rollback play if the canary fails?
sasha: Build: gs://redwood-builds/embeddings/release-v2.4.0-zz9.tar.gz (built from main @ def456). Staging smoke/integration passed. Rollback is a single-image revert + flush KV. I pasted tested commands below.
jamie: @deploybot please run preflight and show any blockers. Tagging @mika for ops eyes.
deploybot: Preflight results: smoke: PASS; infra-checks: PASS; canary-tests: RECOMMENDED but SME requested micro-canary; migrations: NONE; open-release-PRs: 0; config-drift: none. Interactive approvals required: ops + product. React with :white_check_mark: within 8m to approve micro-canary + rollout.
mika: Oncall here. +1 for micro-canary. Need explicit rollback commands and a kill-switch in case of rapid regressions. Put them in thread and I'll ack.
sasha: Rollback steps (ops-tested in staging):
```
# quick rollback to previous stable image and flush KV
kubectl -n inference set image deployment/embed-service embed=redwood/embed:v2.3.3
./scripts/flush-kv.sh --cluster eu-west1 --service embed-service --confirm
```
Also we keep a traffic-split safe-mode: 10% -> 100% shift over 120s after canary OK. If error_rate > 0.8% or p95 > 2.5x baseline during canary, abort and run rollback.
rohan: :white_check_mark: (ops)
jamie: Product signoff: asked tess via DM; she said "ok to micro-canary, escalate if customers notice" — posting for record.
jamie: Approved. Triggering deploy id deploy_1779995001_microcanary. Canary: 1 node for 3m, then staged roll to 6 nodes.
deploybot: Deploy triggered by jamie. Canary step started (node-07). Progress: canary: updating node-07 -> patching image.
deploybot: Canary node updated, health checks PASS. Waiting 3m observation window.
# +3m
rohan: Monitoring p95 and errors; at +2m looks stable.
mika: Observability: redis-ejects normalizing. No OOMs on canary. I'm green to proceed to staged roll.
jamie: Proceeding to staged roll -> rolling remaining 5 nodes, concurrency 1.
deploybot: Rolling... 2/6 updated; 4/6 updated; 6/6 updated. Post-deploy smoke: PASS. Traffic split moved to 100% over 2m. Monitoring window 10m.
sasha: +7m post full-roll: error rate back to baseline, p95 improved. No customer reports.
jamie: I'll update release notes: "hotfix(embed): pin runtime to v2.4.0 — fixes KV GC causing OOM/503 under concurrency" and notify support to annotate impacted tickets. Thanks for the quick approvals and coordinated ops checks :rocket:
